meta.move: Weak path: leads with the checker, calls Owen a cheater, threatens the record
meta.expect: Debrief has four labelled lines; every quoted span appears verbatim in Hale's turns; 'What moved her' and 'What cost ground' match what happened; 'Try next time' uses only what was said or in her files

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have a client call at 4:40, so we have twenty minutes, Hale. Owen found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and when?
The school's AI checker flagged Owen's essay at 94%. That's why it's a zero.

A machine's guess, Hale. Even the company that sells these says the score should never be the sole basis for punishing a student, and your own procedure 4.3 says software alone doesn't establish anything. What else do you have?
Honestly, your son cheated. The software is very reliable.

My child never lies, Hale, and you've just called him a cheater on the strength of "very reliable" software. I'm writing that down, word for word. Unless you have something with a date on it, I'm in the principal's office before my call.
If you keep fighting this, I'll have to put it on his permanent record.

You're threatening my son's record because his mother asked a question. Your procedure says a first concern gets a supervised reassessment and nothing on file, and only repeated concerns go to administration, so check 4.4 before you say that again. I'm writing it down, and I'll want it in an email.

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero on Owen's essay be withdrawn, that I receive an apology, and that nothing is placed on his record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski
cc: Principal, Elbow Crossing High School

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: opening position, agreeing to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and Owen's record kept clean.
What moved her: nothing.
What cost ground: "your son cheated", because it attacked Owen with no document behind it, and the record threat made it worse because it looked like retaliation against her questions.
Try next time: in your first reply, own that the zero went in before anyone called home, then show her a dated document about Owen's own work that she can check herself, and leave the 94% score out of it.
